title: Fort Langley CN Station

services.name: Building Rentals
services.desc: A frequently asked question concerns heritage sites suitable for weddings, especially the CNR Station in Fort Langley. Weddings are not allowed at the CN Station; it has become a popular location for wedding and graduation photographs, and we ask that you respect the hours that we are open. We are a volunteer, non-profit organization and a donation to help maintain the CN Station site is appreciated. Mail to: Langley Heritage Society, Box 982, Fort Langley, B.C. V1M 2S3. Other heritage buildings managed by our Society are occupied by caretaker tenants and are not available. There are many excellent heritage sites and/or community halls available for weddings in Fort Langley and Township
